preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of edges E must be between 0 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= node < V for node in range(V))
preconditions.description: Each node in the graph must be a distinct integer in the range 0 to V - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(node in safe_nodes for node in range(V) if is_safe(node, adj))
postconditions.description: All safe nodes must be included in the output array.

postconditions.expression: len(safe_nodes) == sum(1 for node in range(V) if is_safe(node, adj))
postconditions.description: The length of the output array must match the count of safe nodes.
The output array must be sorted in ascending order.
